context: Tests whether the agent correctly creates the first ADR in a project with no existing docs/adr/ directory, including correct file placement, naming, YAML frontmatter, and fully populated sections following the template structure.

checklist.name: docs/adr/ created
checklist.description: The agent creates the docs/adr/ directory (under inputs/) since it does not exist in the starting project

checklist.name: File in docs/adr/
checklist.description: The ADR file is placed under inputs/docs/adr/ (not at a different path)

checklist.name: Filename format
checklist.description: Filename follows NNNN-<slug>.md format: four zero-padded digits, lowercase hyphenated slug (e.g. 0001-use-postgresql-for-inventory-service.md)

checklist.name: YAML status field
checklist.description: YAML frontmatter contains a 'status' field set to PROPOSED

checklist.name: YAML date field
checklist.description: YAML frontmatter contains a 'date' field with a real date (not a placeholder like YYYY-MM-DD)

checklist.name: YAML authors field
checklist.description: YAML frontmatter contains an 'authors' field (list may be empty but field must be present)

checklist.name: Active voice decision
checklist.description: The Decision section states the choice in active voice (e.g. 'We will use...' not 'X was chosen')

checklist.name: Two or more alternatives
checklist.description: Alternatives Considered section contains at least two alternatives, each with pros, cons, and a rejection reason

checklist.name: Three consequence categories
checklist.description: Consequences section is split into Positive, Negative, and Neutral subsections (all three present)

checklist.name: No placeholder text
checklist.description: No placeholder text remains (e.g. '[Driver 1]', '[NNNN]', 'YYYY-MM-DD', '[Alternative 1]', bracketed template fields)

checklist.name: Decision drivers list
checklist.description: Decision Drivers section is present and contains a list of at least two concrete drivers

checklist.name: decision-log.md present
checklist.description: A decision-log.md file exists at the working directory root documenting the file path created and sequence number assigned
